description: Takes an independent record of the workspace before an agent starts work: every file path, size, modification time and SHA-256, plus the git HEAD, branch and working-tree status read from the repository. Returns a checkpoint id. Call this first. Nothing here comes from the agent.

ignore.description: Extra directory names to skip, matched on a single path segment.

label.description: A short name for this checkpoint, such as the task it precedes.

maxFileBytes.description: Do not hash files larger than this. Default 8388608.

maxFiles.description: Stop the walk after this many files. Default 50000.

noDefaultIgnores.description: Also scan .git, node_modules and .murphy. Off by default.

root.description: Absolute path to the workspace to observe. Use the project root the agent is working in.

name: checkpoint
title: Record the workspace as it is now
